scientific_integrity: Entire exact all-target fiber theorem proved from the semidirect power operator and a cyclic-module Jordan filtration. Independent direct finite checks cover 22 examples, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic-p elementary-abelian bases and a regular cyclic top, and powers with exponent \(p^b\); non-elementary abelian wreath bases are outside scope. The Hall power identity and n=p rank-one norm are classical. Historical priority subject to inaccessible 2014 full text and unindexed results.
title: Complete prime-power word fibers and power-image subgroup thresholds in cyclic regular wreath groups
